newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan tea prices mixed in good general demand.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan tea prices mixed in good general demand.

text.p: Tea prices were mixed at the Kenyan export auction in the port of Mombasa on Monday and maintained good general demand, traders said.
Brighter and medium BP1s held about firm while lower mediums appreciated by two to four U.S. cents. Brighter PF1s were irregularly easier by 4-10 cents following quality.
Selected PDusts met good competition and advanced by 10 cents with other sorts gaining up to eight cents and more.
Well sorted fannings and Dusts were a strong feature. BMFs were firm to dearer.
Pakistan blenders and Egypt were the main buyers.
